Rule: attribute part: title "attr of M", name McshEngl.M'attr · specific part: title "M.specific", name McshEngl.M.specific
A part can be in one TITLE-* and one NAME-* list.

SUMMARY
  TITLE-DASH         0  title X differs from the main-name M only by - vs _
  TITLE-LOCAL     5257  title uses another (local short?) name Y in place of the main-name M
  TITLE-OTHER     1378  title is neither "attr of X" nor "X.specific"
  NAME-MISSING    1265  no McshEngl.M'… (attribute) / McshEngl.M.… (specific) name at all
  NAME-OTHER      3015  has McshEngl.M'… / M.… names, but not the one of the title
  NO-NAME          169  part-section with no name:: paragraph
